scripts.build:wasm:release: cargo build --target=wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sendblob.wasm --out-dir=web/src/wasm --out-name=sendblob --target=web --weak-refs && wasm-opt -Oz --strip-producers --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-mutable-globals --enable-sign-ext web/src/wasm/sendblob_bg.wasm -o web/src/wasm/sendblob_bg.wasm.opt && mv web/src/wasm/sendblob_bg.wasm.opt web/src/wasm/sendblob_bg.wasm
